_comment: Workbook exercise plant-cooling-tower (docs/workbook/plant-cooling-tower.md): the heat-rejection side of the lbnl-chiller plant (tower 1 and the condenser loop). cooling_tower_approach keeps the dataset template's 8.1 F design approach, calibrated from the fault-free run's median approach at high fan (the simulated tower's design curve is not published; see configs/lbnl-chiller.json), and its default 90% fan-effort gate, so the approach is judged only when the tower works at its limit. condenser_water_reset (default 0.3 F-per-F slope) asks whether the condenser-water supply follows the wet-bulb. condenser_bypass_leak (default 2 F warn / 5 F fault) compares the water entering the chillers with the water leaving the tower while the bypass valve is commanded shut. chiller_efficiency is left to the plant-chiller-efficiency exercise.
